items.title: Maplebear (CART) Sale Faces Fresh Fairness Scrutiny
items.summary: Multiple investor rights law firms have opened investigations into the planned sale of Maplebear (NasdaqGS:CART) to DoorDash. The probes focus on whether Maplebear shareholders are receiving fair consideration and full, accurate disclosures under federal securities laws.
